ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached diagram shows a generator on the left labeled X0=0.03, connected to a first transformer labeled X0=0.1, then a short feeder/reactor labeled X0=0.05, then a second transformer labeled X0=0.07, ending at point B on the right. The transformer connection sketches show a delta side on the first transformer that blocks zero-sequence current toward the generator, and a grounded/neutral impedance of 0.25 is shown on the right-side transformer neutral. Reasoning: Looking into point B for the zero-sequence Thevenin equivalent, the generator branch is excluded because the delta winding of the first transformer prevents zero-sequence current from reaching the generator. The remaining zero-sequence path includes the second transformer, the feeder, and the first transformer in series. The neutral grounding impedance on the right side contributes three times its value in the zero-sequence network: 3(0.25)=0.75 pu. The reactive part is the sum of the indicated series zero-sequence reactances: j(0.07+0.05+0.10)=j0.22 pu. Therefore, Z0,Th(B)=0.75+j0.22 pu.

method.method_draft: After describing the diagram, inject a 1 pu zero-sequence test current at point B to ground and suppress the generator source. Use the transformer connection information to prune branches that cannot carry external zero-sequence current; the generator and its X0=0.03 plus its 0.25 neutral grounding do not lie in the test-current path. The test current sees voltage drops across the B-side grounding contribution 3×0.25, the second transformer j0.07, the feeder j0.05, and the first transformer j0.10. Therefore Vtest=1·[0.75+j(0.07+0.05+0.10)], so ZTh=Vtest/1=0.75+j0.22 pu.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中从左到右依次为发电机、第一台变压器、短馈线、第二台变压器以及右端的点 B。标注的零序阻抗为：发电机 X0=0.03，第一台变压器 X0=0.1，馈线 X0=0.05，第二台变压器 X0=0.07。图中还显示发电机中性点经 0.25 接地；第二台变压器靠近 B 的一侧也有中性点经 0.25 接地。推理：按指定方法，在点 B 对地注入 1 pu 零序测试电流，并将发电机电源抑制。根据变压器接线关系，不能承载外部零序测试电流的支路应剪除，因此发电机及其 X0=0.03 和发电机中性点 0.25 接地阻抗不在测试电流路径中。测试电流从 B 看到的串联零序路径包括：B 侧中性点接地贡献 3×0.25=0.75，第二台变压器 j0.07，馈线 j0.05，以及第一台变压器 j0.10。因此 Vtest = 1 × [0.75 + j(0.07+0.05+0.10)] = 0.75 + j0.22。由于测试电流为 1 pu，ZTh = Vtest / 1 = 0.75 + j0.22 pu。
